Pool template for CRDS contact info entries.

# Purpose
Defines a pool-backed storage type for `fd_contact_info_t` records used by the gossip CRDS code. The `fd_crds_contact_info_entry` structure stores one `fd_contact_info_t` object and a `pool.next` link field for free-list management. The file then sets `POOL_NAME`, `POOL_T`, and `POOL_NEXT` and includes `fd_pool.c` to generate the pool implementation for `crds_contact_info_pool`.
